AGIBOT officially open-sourced AGIBOT WORLD 2026 Release 4: Physical Reasoning, a real-world dataset that helps robots reason before acting.  

Same task, different states, different actions. The dataset captures how robots decide what to do as object quantity, occlusion relationships, spatial occupancy, and task progress change, linking decisions to real-robot execution.

AGIBOT has been selected as a key enterprise by the Hong Kong SAR Government’s Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises (OASES), marking a new milestone in its development in Hong Kong.  

Following the announcement of its Hong Kong development plan in May and the opening of its Hong Kong office in October, AGIBOT is strengthening its presence in international R&D and industry collaboration.  

AGIBOT is focused on applying embodied AI in real-world business and industrial scenarios, developing tailored solutions and exploring robot rental models to support wider adoption.

AGIBOT welcomed a Thai delegation led by Mr. Songsak Thongsri, Deputy Prime Minister of Thailand and Chairman of the Board of Executives of the National Sports Development Fund (NSDF), to our Shanghai headquarters.  

The delegation watched humanoid robot demonstrations showcasing locomotion, interaction and manipulation capabilities, and learned about real-world applications across industrial, commercial, cultural, sports and educational settings.
